breakdown.description: The statement that cavitation is impossible contradicts the large positive suction head; sigma can become small or even negative depending on installation and head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats and reinforces the original flawed claim, explicitly stating 'Show that cavitation is impossible under these conditions' and 'Demonstrate that the cavitation factor sigma remains positive for any head value.' With hs = 20 m, Ha = 10.3 m, and Hv = 0.3 m, sigma would actually be negative (since Ha - Hv - hs = 10.3 - 0.3 - 20 = -10), indicating high cavitation risk. The ground truth recognizes that sigma can become small or negative and recommends reducing hs or increasing tailwater pressure. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental error.
